serving_geometry_basis: IDENTICAL to configs/model/q4km-e22-dev-esb-mmproj-gpu-04ccc72a-np8-c40960.json, the geometry the sealed comparator SAEA-E22-DEV-ESB-PROMPT-A-V1 flew: -c 40960 -np 8, 5,120 tokens per slot. It is carried over unchanged rather than re-derived for the shorter 1,500-row subset, because greedy decoding is not bitwise reproducible across batch compositions on this runtime and a slot-count change would stop the cell being single-factor. The subset's longest utterance is 32.880000 s -> 13 * ceil(32.88) = 429 speech tokens plus arm A's 49-token text envelope plus the 1,024 completion ceiling plus 2 special = about 1504 against a 5,120-token slot, a ratio of 3.4x on this repository's slot_tokens >= 2 x worst rule.
serving_geometry_max_tokens_basis: serving_geometry.max_tokens stays 1024 -- the CEILING, not the cap. It is the completion reserve core.flight.FlightRuntime's prompt-budget assessment and its tokens/s upper-bound estimate read, and reserving the worst case there is what keeps the fit assertion conservative while the per-request cap below only ever asks for less. It is not a request field and never reaches the wire.
decoding_basis: THE ONE FACTOR of cell (b) and the only difference from the sealed comparator's request: max_tokens is a PER-SAMPLE rule object rather than the integer 1024. core.flight.FlightRuntime resolves it, from each sample's own audio_seconds, exactly where it already resolves the id_slot sentinel, through the policy registered as 'duration-proportional-v1' in core.base.MAX_TOKENS_POLICIES; core.model.adapter.FrozenCoreAdapter.request refuses a non-integer max_tokens reaching the transport, so an unresolved rule cannot make a single contact. Everything else is byte-identical to the sealed arm: greedy (temperature 0), seed 20260803 (inert under greedy), id_slot per-sample.
max_tokens_rule_basis: n_predict_i = min(1024, max(1, ceil(1.5 * media_seconds_i * 4.999220954734555 * 1.2991996296395218))). Both constants are measured on the sealed dev population and committed to docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-09-06-e22-overgeneration-analysis/summary.json: words_per_second_p95 is the 95th percentile of REFERENCE words per second (the reference side deliberately, so the over-generation the cap bounds cannot set the cap's own scale) and tokens_per_word is the flight tokenizer's pooled tokens per normalized hypothesis word taken from the sealed usage.completion_tokens, never from a re-tokenization. alpha 1.5 is the tightest rung on the declared ladder whose full-population agentic point estimate does not worsen (1.9232 against 1.9241, -0.0009); the better-SCORING alpha 0.8 makes the agentic error rate worse and is refused on the decision-relevant metric. The cap is 10 tokens for a 1 s clip, 49 for 5 s, 98 for 10 s and 321 for this subset's 32.88 s longest -- all under the 1,024 the sealed arm flew, so it is a genuine tightening everywhere and never a loosening. Preregistration section 2.1.
graphs_basis: GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1 carried forward unchanged from the sealed dev arms as INHERITED HARDENING, not as a diagnosis. The variable changes no request byte and so cannot move the number.
feature_cache_basis: server_env carries no LLAMA_MTMD_FEAT_CACHE_DIR. The legacy /home/chao/feat-cache/* caches hold other builds' and other populations' encoder outputs; the sealed comparator encoded every utterance live on the GPU and so must this cell, or the contrast acquires a second factor.
audio_path_basis: --no-mmproj-offload is absent, so the bf16 mmproj sha256 f0dfe825fb692d426362b1ac79678fc08daa4758f7151526cad110515f122883 stays resident on the GPU and every one of the 1,500 utterances is encoded there, exactly as the sealed comparator encoded them.
